teleporter/32036.htm.text: Temple Gatekeeper: As you approach the huge statue, its eyes fix upon you with a scrutinizing gaze.

ai/npc/Teleports/PaganTeleporters/noMark.text: The Temple Gatekeeper: Show your Mark or be gone from my sight! Only those who possess the Pagan's Mark may pass through this gate!

ai/npc/Teleports/PaganTeleporters/openDo.text: The Temple Gatekeeper: On seeing the Pagan's Mark, the statue's probing eyes go blank. With the quiet whir of an engine, the gate swings open...
